rules.title: Prohibition on selling, licensing, or providing algorithmic rent-setting devices to landlords
rules.requirement: It would be unlawful for any person to sell, license, or otherwise provide an algorithmic device (software using nonpublic competitor data to recommend rental rates or occupancy levels) to a landlord.
rules.coverage_text: Any person providing algorithmic devices to landlords for residential rental property in the City of San Diego.

exemption_tests.description: Software used to publish reports on rental rates or occupancy from aggregated historical nonpublic competitor data more than 90 days old, or from public information, that does not recommend rates for future leases or renewals.
Software used to establish rental rates or income limits in accordance with local, state, or federal affordable housing program guidelines.

rules.exemptions_text: Algorithmic device excludes aggregated historical (90+ days old) or public-data reporting software that does not recommend future rates, and software used for affordable housing program rent/income limits.
rules.quoted_span: It is unlawful for a person to sell, license, or otherwise provide an algorithmic device to a landlord.
rules.penalty: Tenant civil action against a landlord for injunctive relief, damages, or civil penalties up to $1,000 per violation, plus attorney's fees (§ 98.1104).
rules.ambiguity_note: Document is a proposed ordinance with blank final passage date and no adoption shown; would take effect 30 days after final passage.

rules.title: Prohibition on landlord use of algorithmic devices to set rents or occupancy levels
rules.requirement: It would be unlawful for a landlord to use an algorithmic device to set rental rates or occupancy levels for residential rental property. Each month of continuing violation, for each property, is a separate violation.
rules.coverage_text: All landlords of residential rental property in the City of San Diego.

exemption_tests.description: Software used to publish reports on rental rates or occupancy from aggregated historical nonpublic competitor data more than 90 days old, or from public information, that does not recommend future rates.
Software used to establish rental rates or income limits in accordance with affordable housing program guidelines.

rules.exemptions_text: Algorithmic device definition excludes aggregated historical/public-data reporting software and affordable housing program rent-setting software.
rules.quoted_span: It is unlawful for a landlord to use an algorithmic device to set rental rates or occupancy levels for residential rental property.
rules.penalty: Tenant may seek injunctive relief, damages, or civil penalties of up to $1,000 per violation; prevailing tenant recovers costs and reasonable attorney's fees (§ 98.1104(a)).
rules.ambiguity_note: Document is a proposed ordinance with blank final passage date and no adoption shown; would take effect 30 days after final passage.
